🔐 Sabiway API Documentation - Authentication

Authentication endpoints for integrating with the Sabiway backend.

Create a new user account.

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "password": "yourpassword"
}

Response:
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com"
  }
}

Authenticate a user and return a token.

Request Body:
{
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "password": "yourpassword"
}

Response:
{
  "token": "jwt-or-session-token",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com"
  }
}

Login or signup using a Google token.

Request Body:
{
  "token": "google-oauth-id-token"
}

Response:
{
  "token": "jwt-or-session-token",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "Jane Doe",
    "email": "jane@gmail.com"
  }
}

Generate the Google OAuth2 authorization URL. Your frontend can call this to redirect users to Google’s login page.

    Response:
    {
      "auth_url": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?client_id=XXXX&redirect_uri=XXXX&response_type=code&scope=openid%20email%20profile"
    }

Send a reset code to the user’s email.

Request Body:
{
  "email": "john@example.com"
}

Response:
{
  "message": "Reset code sent to email"
}

Verify the 4-digit reset code.

Request Body:
{
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "code": "1234"
}

Response:
{
  "message": "Code confirmed",
  "reset_token": "uuid-token"
}

Reset the user’s password using the reset token.

Request Body:
{
  "password": "newsecurepassword"
}

Response:
{
  "message": "Password reset successful"
}

Logout the current user and invalidate token/session.

Response:
{
  "message": "Successfully logged out"
}
